shortDescription: Emergent RimWorld harassment/bondage/control addon for RimJobWorld: abuse-gated conditioning with per-pawn susceptibility, a floating "Command deck" Harem window, weekly pet market, world-incident + notoriety layer (Karma integration), Tales, Ideology + Biotech integration, blackmail photos, a per-tick pawn-index + portrait-cache performance framework, and broad mod compat.
body:
# RimJobWorld - Sexual Harassment C# addon for **RimJobWorld** (hard dep) + **Harmony**. Emergent harassment adapted from AAF Sexual Harassment (F4). Soft deps: SpeakUp, RimTalk, Karma & Reputation, c0ffee Animations, Melee Animation, [NL] Facial Animation, Onahole Extension, Rimpsyche, Modern Bio Tab, Simple Slavery Collars, BondageBed Torture, RJW Quirks/Sexperience/Genes. DLC-aware: Ideology + Biotech layers load only when active (LoadFolders IfModActive). ## Workflow rule (global) Before ANY movement/rename/delete of source files, versioned timestamped backup to `D:\Rimworld\\\`. D: = /d in git-bash. Global rules live in `_dev\GLOBAL_RULES.md`. Key engineering rules: **Frameworks Over Duplicated Code** and **Robust On Error** (try/catch every tick/entry point, kill-switch + fail-open). Finish work with 4 passovers + an honest 1-100% confidence score per fix. ## AUDIT + REMEDIATION STATUS Full report: `Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.md` (+ .pdf, 12pp). Regenerate PDF: `python Docs/_mkpdf.py Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.md Docs/QuadPass_Audit_2025.html` then Edge `--headless=new --print-to-pdf` (Windows paths + `file:///` URL). Backups: `20260731-133346` (pre-A), `20260801-091824` (pre-C). ### TRANCHE A - DONE, tested in-game (runs #235/#244, zero errors ours) - **C1** `SoftDeps.ModActive(packageId)` - ALL soft-dep probes route through it. `GetActiveModWithIdentifier` exact-matches but Steam mods carry `ModMetaData.SteamModPostfix` = `"_steam"`, so 6 of 11 probes were silently false here. **Never call `GetActiveModWithIdentifier` directly for a soft dep.** - **U10** deleted `Patch_HaremResizeGrip` (postfix on `Verse.Window.WindowOnGUI` = every window, every IMGUI event); `Window_Harem` overrides `WindowOnGUI` instead. Coordinates there are SCREEN space (post-`GUI.Window`, outside the group). - **T1** `MapComponent_HarassmentScan.Due(now, interval, phase)` + per-map `_mapPhase`. **GOTCHA:** the nested onahole `% 600` check MUST also use `Due(now, 600, 0)` - 600 is a multiple of followTick's 60 and shares `_mapPhase`; a raw `% 600` would never fire. - **C2** `_onaholeBedTypeTried` / `_beOnaholeTypeTried` sentinels. **T4** `RecomputeHeadGirls` static scratch, cleared on entry AND exit. ### TRANCHE B - DONE, tested in-game New **`Portraits`** static in `UI/ModernStyle.cs` is the ONLY caller of `PortraitsCache.Get`. - **`Portraits.Sizer`** (struct, one field per portrait) - snapped 32px size while a rect is moving, exact size after 6 stable frames. Fixes the resize VRAM leak: PortraitsCache keys on (size x offset x zoom x rot x flags) and parks expired RenderTextures in a pool only ever emptied by `PortraitsCache.Clear()` (load/quit), so an unquantised resize-derived size stranded ~1.5 MB per pixel of drag. Used by `Window_Harem._dollSizer`, `Dialog_Stylist._dollSizer`, `Dialog_DressUp._dollSizer`. - **`Portraits.PortraitBucket`** - {32,48,64,96,128} ladder via `size*0.9`; 8 RenderTexture families per pawn -> 3. - All portraits draw with **`ScaleMode.ScaleToFit`** (snapped request letterboxes instead of stretching; identical to stretch-fill when request == rect). - **Repaint gating:** portraits, `DrawBorderIcons`, `DrawStageCorners`. Never gate `ButtonInvisible`/`TextField`/scroll views. - **Zoom:** quantised 1/20 during the transition only; exact at the target. Residual is bounded (pool recycles by w,h), not a leak. - **Culling:** roster column computes `first`/`last` from `_scroll.y`. ### TRANCHE C - DONE (builds clean, 4 passovers). NOT YET TESTED IN-GAME. - **U8 roster caching.** `AllPets()` is memoised per Unity frame (`_rosterFrame`/`_allPetsCache`) and de-dupes via a `HashSet` instead of `List.Contains` (was O(n^2)). `FilterSortPets()` is memoised per (frame, signature of count/sort/desc/filter) into reusable `_shownCache`/`_shownScratch`, uses `IndexOf(..., OrdinalIgnoreCase)` instead of two `ToLowerInvariant()` allocations per pawn, and holds four cached `Comparison` delegates so the sort allocates nothing. Net: these ran 2-6x per frame (IMGUI Layout + Repaint + one per input event); now once per frame. **Note the sig only guards WITHIN a frame - across frames it always rebuilds, which is the correct granularity since pets/profiles change.** - **U6 `ModernStyle.FillBar`.** All 12 `Widgets.FillableBar` call sites in Window_Harem + SexualityPanelDrawer converted to tinted `BaseContent.WhiteTex` quads; both per-colour `Dictionary` caches (`_barCache`, `_texCache`) deleted. Geometry mirrors vanilla exactly (border, 3px inset, bg, width-scaled fill). **Deliberately NOT converted: `Gizmo_Conditioning.cs`** - its 4 bar textures are `static readonly` (created once, not per-call), so it is not the batching problem, and the gizmo draw path is untested; low value, non-zero risk. - **U11 gizmo frame-cache.** `Patch_Pawn_GetGizmos` memoises the built list per (thingIDNumber, `Time.frameCount`); `GetGizmos` runs every frame per selected pawn and was allocating a List plus a stream of `Command_*` objects (each with label concat, closure, and for `Command_Target` a fresh `TargetingParameters` + validator lambda). Keyed on int, cleared on frame turnover, so at most one frame of retention. - **U7 border-icon rects** cached in a `List` keyed on the window rect; rebuilt on resize, not per repaint. - **F1 (partial).** `ModernStyle.GrayBtn` promoted; `Dialog_DressUp.GrayBtn` and `Dialog_Stylist.GrayBtn` (byte-identical copies) now forward to it. **`Window_Harem.GrayButton` deliberately NOT folded** - it differs by 0.89 vs 0.90 label grey and an 8px vs 6px truncate margin, and the Command deck is laid out against those metrics. Documented in place so a later pass does not "helpfully" unify it and shift pixels. - **Still open in C:** `DrawSummaryCard`'s O(n) average/risk loop still runs once per pass (cheap arithmetic, not cached). ### DEAD UI LAYOUT - AWAITING A DECISION (not touched) Six top-level draw methods in `Window_Harem.cs` have **zero call sites** - the pre-"Concept 3" layout: `DrawHarem`, `DrawPetList`, `DrawDetailPanel`, `DrawRoster`, `DrawColonyPanel`, `DrawViewToggle`, plus exclusive helpers (`DrawGroup`, `DrawPetCard`, `DrawHaremRow/Header/Summary`, `DrawRosterRow`, `DrawDetailTabs`...). The `_view` field and `ViewNames = {"Pets","Harem"}` are vestiges of that toggle. Consequence: **the Harem-table culling added in Tranche B sits in dead code** (correct if revived; the LIVE culling win is the roster column). A naive reachability script claimed ~975 dead lines but has false positives - it misses calls from property bodies (`EnsureFontH`, `DrawGlance` x21, `DrawSchedule` x3 are all live). **Do not bulk-delete on the script's word;** needs a hand pass + backup. ### FACIAL ANIMATION REGRESSION - FIXED Pawns' mouths flapped open/shut continuously. **Cause was a def, not the bridge.** `RJWSH_FA_Afraid` (a PERSISTENT thought-gated face) claimed `mouthShapeDef`; `AnimationFrameAccumulator` resolves every channel as **last non-null writer wins, recomputed each tick**, so it fought FA's always-on `Constant` animation (breathing) for the mouth and the winner alternated. `RJWSH_FA_Hollow` had the same bug on `lidShapeDef` vs the blink cycle (flickering eyes, unreported). **CHANNEL RULE:** a persistent thought-gated FaceAnimationDef may claim ONLY `headShapeDef` + `browShapeDef`. Mouth/lid belong to `Constant.xml` and `ForJobs/*.xml`. FA's own `Thoughts.xml` obeys this. Palette is head (normal|blush) x brow (angled|flat|normal|s-shaped); differentiate on brow. One-shots are exempt - they go to `forcedTemporaryAnimationList`, drained by `RemoveAll(IsFinished)` rather than Reset-looping, so with a finite `` they play once and may claim mouth/lid. Faces now: Nervous = blush+s-shaped; Afraid = blush+angled; Hollow = normal+flat; Devoted = blush+normal. **FABridge was exonerated and re-enabled** (it has a documented `Enabled` kill switch, `static readonly` not `const` to avoid CS0162). FA's `PlayTemporaryAnimation(Pawn, int startTick, params string[])` takes a **start tick, not a duration** - passing `GenTicks.TicksGame` is correct. ### REMAINING - Tranche D T2 route the 5 interval scans through the existing `_humanlikes`/`_profiled` index. C3 re-key `FindLockedVictimForKey` statics to int ids (they hold a live `CompHoloCryptoStamped` + `Pawn` -> roots a dead Game graph). T3 cap/reorder `MemoryReactionScan`'s `LineOfSight`. F2 TickScheduler. T5 (**data risk**) prune `GameComponent.profiles` - never pruned, deep-Scribed into every save. F3 continue the partial-class split of the 6577-line HarassmentEngine.cs. **Unexploited ACTIVE integrations:** Vanilla Skills Expanded ExpertiseDefs (Phase E flagship, confirmed installed); **check-first risk pair** `Mlie.Suppression` (overlaps SlaveryHooks.SyncSuppression) + `Mlie.PrisonersDontHaveKeys` (overlaps Holokey inventory logic); then Nudity Matters More, Privacy Please, RimHUD, Grudges!, Rimpsyche-Disposition, Restraints/SimpleRestraintBelt, Epitaph/In Memoriam, VSIE, MorePrecepts/AlphaMemes. Melee Animation is claimed as a soft dep but has NO implementing code. ### OTHER MODS - findings from the test runs (for their own sessions) - **Modern CC:** a saved pawn ("Kara 'Mercer' Mercer") deserialises against missing defs (`TraitDef GAT_Ares`, backstory `MSSRPG_Backstory_CircleOfTheStars`, `HediffDef Cisgender`/`NarrowShoulders`) -> 11 cascading errors ending in `SaveableFromNode` NREs and null needs. Null-check def resolution when loading presets. - **Itemization Overhaul - Core:** `Failed to get last layer on apparel item` - calls `.Last()` on `apparel.layers`, which is empty for any malformed third-party def (here `Apparel_PAHMechaBunnyEars`). Needs a `NullOrEmpty` guard. - **Wayfarers / Psycasts²:** `Could not find player faction` from two distinct call paths - something reads `Faction.OfPlayer` before it exists (move to `FinalizeInit`). ## Performance framework - **PawnIndex.cs** per-tick pawn index (`_byId` + `_humanlikes` + `_profiled`, rebuilt at most once per game tick); `PawnById(id)` O(1). **Gap (T2, open): the five interval scans still bypass it.** - **PawnLookup** `OnMap`/`AnyMap`. **PawnFlagCache** tick-scoped memo for collar/onahole predicates, keyed on pawn ids. - **Tick phasing** `Due(now, interval, phase)` + per-map `_mapPhase`. - **UI/ModernStyle.cs** `Portraits` (single gate for `PortraitsCache.Get`), `FillBar`, `GrayBtn`. - **Window_Harem** per-frame roster/filter caches; per-frame gizmo cache in `Patch_Pawn_GetGizmos`. ## Facial Animation defs (FacialAnimation/Defs/FaceAnims_Harassment.xml) - IfModActive Nals.FacialAnimation PERSISTENT thought-gated: RJWSH_FA_Nervous/_Afraid/_Hollow/_Devoted (head+brow only - see channel rule above). ONE-SHOT via FABridge: RJWSH_FA_Flinch/_Cry/_Bliss, priority 400, finite durations. **GOTCHA:** FaceAnimationDef's ctor defaults targetJobs to ["ConstantJob"], and FA applies any ConstantJob def with NO targetThoughtDefs to EVERY pawn every tick - so one-shots carry a sentinel `
  • RJWSH_NeverAmbient
    • `. ## Performance settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs) **enableDepthSystems** (ON), **enableAmbientBanter** (ON) + **ambientBanterScale** (0.6), **affectionInterval** (3000), **begInterval** (450); 0 disables either interval. ## EXPANSION ROADMAP (phases A-E) A (DONE) #7 notoriety/Karma + #1 Tales. B (DONE) #2 chronicle + #3 owner death/legacy. C (DONE) #4 nemesis + #6 blackmail. D (DONE) #8 Ideology rituals + #5 interactive training. **E (next):** #10 Devoted endgame roles as VSE ExpertiseDefs + #9 Hospitality integration. ## Target selection & attraction (HarassmentEngine.cs) `TryRunOnMap` weighted-picks a harasser (HarasserWillingness) then `FindTarget` builds a victim pool. **Sex/orientation gate = `IsAttracted(harasser,target)` (public).** `JobDriver_Harass` re-checks `IsAttracted` during the walk (FailOn) AND at arrival. Player-directed grope/force bypasses the re-check. ## Interactive training (Phase D - #5 - Window_TrainingSession.cs) `interactiveTraining` (default ON): Command deck **Discipline** opens a read-the-pet minigame. 3 rounds; hidden state (Defiant/Fearful/Yearning) leaked by a "tell"; owner picks Firm/Gentle/Degrade. ## Ideology rituals (Phase D - #8) Two optional rites gated to the **RJWSH_Ownership meme**: collaring ceremony + devotion parade. PLAYER-initiated, ROLE-LESS gather-party, outcome worker subclasses RitualOutcomeEffectWorker_FromQuality. **UNTESTED IN-GAME - highest-risk surface.** ## Tales / Chronicle / Owner death / Nemesis / Blackmail Tales: `TaleHelper.Record` null-guarded; 6 TaleDefs. Chronicle: `PawnProfile.chronicle` (cap 100), History tab. Owner death: Harmony Postfix on Pawn.Kill -> OnOwnerDied. Nemesis: escaped/sold pets return as raid leaders. Blackmail: photo gizmo -> faction demand. Shared helpers: `SpawnAssaultRaid` / `PickRaidFaction`. ## Notoriety x Karma & Reputation (ReputationBridge in Bridges.cs) `AddNotoriety(amt, reason)` = local 0-100 meter + mirror -amt*3 colony infamy. World-incident pacing scales with colony regard. No-ops without Karma. ## Harem window (Window_Harem.cs) - "Command deck" FLOATING Window (Modern Suite, accent-LEFT tabs). Live layout = left roster + center STAGE / MARKET PODIUM + right OPS (Commands, Schedule, context tabs) + COLONY OPS + bulk bar. Owns its resize grip via a `WindowOnGUI` override. Tailor/Stylist/Photos drawn INLINE (`_opsMode`). ~2900 lines, a sizeable pre-Concept-3 layout of which is dead (see above). ## Pet market / Conditioning / Break stages GameComponent.market weekly; BuyMarketPawn -> collar to StrongestOrLeader. Collar SEVERITY grants Masochist/Stockholm (abuse-gated + susceptibility). BreakStage {Defiant,Wavering,Compliant,Devoted,Broken}. Escape/sale/rescue -> RegisterNemesis. **`GameComponent.profiles` still has no pruning path (T5).** ## Settings (Settings.cs / Mod.cs) masterEnabled, enableSounds, interactiveTraining, showControlTab, showSexualityTab (default OFF), hideKeyHolderGizmos, enableFleeBeating/BeatToDeath, conditioningInstallsQuirks/Gene, **Performance: enableDepthSystems, enableAmbientBanter, ambientBanterScale, affectionInterval, begInterval**, etc. ## Conventions Vanilla sentence case, ASCII hyphen only. Event.current not Input. **UI = Modern Suite.** Harmony PatchAll (astryl.RJWSexualHarassment). Rituals: player-started + role-less + FromQuality subclass ONLY. **Attraction gate = HarassmentEngine.IsAttracted.** **Perf: id->Pawn via PawnLookup/PawnById; hot predicates via PawnFlagCache; never re-add a linear AllPawnsSpawned scan for an id lookup.** **Soft-dep probes go through `SoftDeps.ModActive`.** **Periodic work goes through `Due(now, interval, phase)` - never a bare `now % N`.** **ALL portraits go through `Portraits.Head`/`Portraits.Body`; never hand `PortraitsCache.Get` an unquantised resize-derived size.** **Bars go through `ModernStyle.FillBar`; no per-colour textures.** **Persistent FA faces: head+brow only.** **Never Harmony-patch a global UI method for our own window chrome.** **Static caches key on thingIDNumber, never a Thing/Pawn reference.** Test companions: astryl.KarmaReputation, astryl.ModernBioTab, rjw.quirks, rjw.sexperience, Vegapnk.rjw.genes, TRIBeagle.simpleslaverycollars, Mlie.BondageBedTorture (+ Ludeon.RimWorld.Ideology).
